claims.claim: UEC commenced production at Burke Hollow in April 2026 and now operates two of three U.S. hub-and-spoke ISR production platforms.
Conversion-facility licensing and design work adds vertical-integration optionality but remains pre-commercial.

risks.risk: Conversion capability remains subject to siting, licensing, design and capital execution.

unknowns.unknown: Conversion facility site, license timing and capital requirement remain unknown.

claims.claim: Fiscal Q3 disclosure reported $794M of liquid assets including $488M cash and no debt, plus 1.456M lb U3O8 inventory at April 30.
Quarter production was 32,195 lb at $54.61 total cost/lb and $46.69 cash cost/lb; cumulative production since commissioning was 276,516 lb at $39.30 total cost/lb.

risks.risk: Quarter unit costs were elevated by low production and regulatory timing; uranium price exposure is deliberately unhedged.

contradictions.contradiction: Strong liquidity and strategic inventory coexist with early-stage production volumes and quarter-specific cost inflation.

unknowns.unknown: Sustainable steady-state Burke Hollow production and unit cost remain unproven.
